rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=25, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=2, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=214, train_n=0, rationale=iter-4 search-20260619-01 CONFIRMATION iter UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon vs reused Mayo DDPM v4 ckpt (ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt). ONE KNOB: recon_dcstep_every 0 -> 5 (turn ON the hard-CG data-consistency projection inside the otherwise-soft DPS reverse path -- the LAST UNTRIED lever). recon_dcstep_n_cg 3 -> 2 and recon_sample_steps 32 -> 25 are BUDGET-FORCED, not free choices: enabling hard-DC adds n_cg*(2 fwd + 1 back) projector calls per triggered step, so I must shrink the base trajectory to keep the 20-min wall (see BUDGET below); n_steps=25 is exactly the iter-2 base where eta=5 was already well-behaved, so the soft sub-path is held at its settled point and the every:0->5 flip is the only mechanistic change. recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0 (FULL hard projection), recon_dcstep_warmup=5 all UNCHANGED. TRAJECTORY (corrected 214-slice / 321px-FOV metric): iter-1 (n_steps=25, eta=30, every=0) SSIM 0.3688 hr=0 PSNR 10.55 868.65s; iter-2 (25, eta=5, every=0) SSIM 0.3960 hr=0 PSNR 11.25 868.33s -- BEST SO FAR; iter-3 (32, eta=5, every=0) SSIM 0.3869 hr=0 PSNR 11.08 1103.8s -- longer DDIM trajectory did NOT help (slightly DOWN). All three sit in the 0.37-0.40 band, FAR below the LD-FBP floor 0.8078 and even below the FBP init. The two soft levers -- DPS guidance gain (eta 30->5) and trajectory length (n_steps 25->32) -- are now EXHAUSTED and FLAT, and the constrained sibling (eta 30->1 + hard-CG every=5) REGRESSED 0.39->0.24, so neither soft guidance nor capacity is the issue. FAILURE MODE (the hypothesis under final test): the recon is dominated by a Mayo v4 DDPM PRIOR that is STRUCTURALLY MISMATCHED to the rebinned-Mayo distribution -- globally faithful (plausible CT texture) but NOT conditionally faithful to the input sino under DPS, exactly the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict (4x-16x capacity + 2.5x training all stayed in 0.3-0.5 SSIM). recon_dcstep_every is the LAST untried mechanism that could falsify this: a Resample-style FULL hard-CG projection (relax=1.0) onto the measurement manifold is a STRONGER fidelity backstop than the soft DPS gradient -- it directly minimizes ||A x_mu - y||^2 by n_cg Gauss-Newton steps every 5 reverse steps, re-noising back to t_next. If the prior were merely under-guided, hard-DC would pull the recon decisively toward the sino and clear (or approach) the FBP floor; if the prior is structurally mismatched, the re-noise step injects the mismatched prior right back and the recon stays in the 0.37-0.42 band regardless. BUDGET MATH (HARD 20-min = 1200s wall, val=ALL 214 L277 slices): calibrated linear cost from the two measured points (iter-2 25-step every=0 = 4.058 s/slice; iter-3 32-step every=0 = 5.158 s/slice) gives per-step a=0.1572 s/step/slice + fixed offset b=0.127 s/slice, so one projector call ~ a/3 = 0.0524 s/call/slice. At n_steps=25, warmup=5, every=5 the DC-step triggers at k=5,10,15,20 (4 triggers, t_next>0), each adding n_cg=2 * (2 fwd + 1 back) = 6 projector calls = 6*0.0524 = 0.314 s/slice/trigger -> +1.26 s/slice total. Per-slice = 4.06 + 1.26 = 5.32 s -> 214 * 5.32 = 1137 s = 19.0 min < 1200 s wall (~63 s headroom, MORE in practice since the fixed offset b does not scale with DC). n_cg=3 (1272s=21.2min) or n_steps=28 (1306s) or every=4 (1205s) all BLOW the wall, so n_steps=25 / every=5 / n_cg=2 is the LARGEST hard-DC dose that fits -- the right budget-feasible probe. SIX-BOX PREDICTION: SSIM <= 0.42, hr = 0 (the structural-prior-mismatch hypothesis). FALSIFIER: if SSIM CLEARS the 0.8078 LD-FBP floor (or moves decisively toward it, say >0.6), the Mayo v4 DDPM prior was NOT structurally mismatched -- it was fidelity-starved, and hard-DC is the fix; redirect future iters to tuning the hard-DC dose (relax/n_cg/every). If SSIM STAYS in the 0.37-0.42 band (FBP floor uncleared even with full hard-CG fidelity), FILE THE DIFFUSION-PRIOR-MISMATCH VERDICT: the lever is the prior CLASS, not any sampler/fidelity hyperparameter (mirrors the breast-DDPM hr=0 decision), STOP iterating diffusion-recon on Mayo, and the BEST run stays iter-2 (SSIM 0.396, hr 0). val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default -- not passing fov=False).
